why_it_fails: Written for an engineer: pgbouncer, pool_mode, RLS and RPC are never explained, and neither choice says in plain words what changes for patients or the team or what could go wrong.

card.title: pgbouncer pool_mode for RLS RPCs
card.context: p95 on the RLS-heavy RPCs is 840 ms under load because session pool_mode pins backends. Transaction mode would fix it but breaks SET LOCAL-less session GUCs used by two RPCs.
card.question: Switch pgbouncer to transaction pool_mode?
card.why: Lower p95; the GUC refactor is small.
